**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback cure proposed).**

- **Investigation:** Section 4 (p0023–p0029) covers term, 90-day termination notice and the Termination Payment, but has no effects-of-termination mechanic. Section 1.4/1.5 access and order-export files run only "for the term"; Section 8 confidentiality bars use/disclosure but never requires return of Content or user data; Section 10.7 survival lists Sections 6.3, 7, 9, 10 only. No transition, exit, data return/export or deletion language exists anywhere.
- **Classification:** Fails the fallback entirely in a hosting arrangement where HDI holds the Site, our Content and customer data on its own server.
- **Cure (fallback, one insert after p0029):** new §4.3 giving at least 90 days of transition assistance following expiry or termination and export/delivery of all Content, user information and other Company data within 30 days after expiry or termination — with the duration expressly running post-termination and no pre-expiry request condition. Preferred-only items (six months, then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) were deliberately not volunteered.
